relay_feature_unselected: The p2p feature is not selected
relay_control_unconfigured: A trusted control service is not configured; pairing and enabling are unavailable. Configure its endpoint and initial trust on the host. This page does not accept arbitrary nodes or IP addresses.
relay_token_requirement: Enabling requires a host recovery Token of at least 43 characters. Replace it in the host configuration; never send it to the control service.
relay_storage_warning: Managed storage is unavailable; new public connections are blocked. Disabling still stops access immediately.
relay_bound_address: Fixed public HTTPS address (no Token; an assigned address does not authorize access)
relay_bulk_warning: Interactive access remains available. New upload, download and forwarding requests are unavailable and will not enter the interactive channel.
relay_enter_code: Enter the one-time pairing code on GitHub:

relay_assignment_disclaimer: Shows only the current assignment; grants no node administration rights. Streams can use different paths, and one session’s status does not represent the entire host.
relay_consent: Relay terminates TLS, can read forwarded content, and acts as a trusted login authority granting remote shell access. This is not end-to-end encryption. Trust only the configured control service; never send it the recovery Token.
relay_delete_consent: Deleting permanently loses the old public address. A new pairing creates a new address. The binding record and this host's local authorization are removed even if remote access closure is unconfirmed; old direct access on an offline host is not guaranteed closed.
relay_disconnect_consent: This disconnects the current Relay entry point, derived logins and optimized links. Persistent terminal processes keep running. The current public page may lose its connection.
relay_paths_aria: Actual interactive paths in this browser
relay_paths_description: Login, settings, files, voice, all forwarding and unclassified requests stay on WSS. Only terminal, chat and list streams may optimize based on actual measurements; one browser may use mixed paths.
relay_optimizer_unavailable: Interactive optimization is unavailable; baseline requests do not wait for ICE.
relay_awaiting_samples: Waiting for stable health and latency-advantage samples
relay_owner_required: No valid Relay owner browser login is active. A recovery Token or device identity cannot obtain TURN credentials.
relay_input_uncertain: The path changed; acceptance of some sent input is unconfirmed. It will not be replayed automatically. Check terminal output or submission status before proceeding.
relay_no_streams: No active interactive streams; a successful candidate connection does not prove application cutover.
relay_logout_description: Signing out closes access to this host, not persistent terminals. Use the owner console to sign out globally; signing out of GitHub does not sign out of WebMux.
relay_logout_error: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Retry; signing out locally does not mean a global console sign-out.
relay_error_host: Cannot reach the host temporarily. State will be checked automatically, or you can check now.
relay_error_persist: Access has stopped, but the disabled state was not persisted. Repair storage and save again.
relay_error_auth: Your login has expired; sign in again.
relay_error_denied: Authorization denied; check the account invitation, owner identity and permissions for this entry point.
relay_error_conflict: An existing binding must be deleted before a fresh pairing, even for the same account. If this installation has no local binding identity, delete it from the owner's console first.
relay_error_unavailable: The control service or assigned node is temporarily unavailable; access stays closed until WSS is ready.
relay_error_unknown: The operation did not complete. Refresh to check its actual state; do not repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.
relay_notice_paired: GitHub host pairing completed; public access must still be enabled separately.
relay_notice_completed: Operation completed; current readiness information determines the running state.
relay_notice_pending: Remote revocation is not confirmed; the local binding is retained. Refresh later and explicitly retry deletion.
relay_diag_bulk: Bulk channel unavailable; interactive streams remain connected
relay_diag_turn: TURN temporarily unavailable; interactive streams stay on WSS
relay_diag_feature: P2P feature not selected; keeping WSS
relay_diag_build: This build does not include P2P; keeping WSS
relay_diag_advantage: Application samples consistently show a stable latency advantage
relay_diag_hidden: Diagnostics contained sensitive transport material and were hidden. Check sanitized host status.
relay_p2p_connected: Candidate passed application sampling; streams reattach independently
relay_p2p_failed: Candidate path unavailable; keeping WebSocket and retrying in the background
relay_p2p_description: Local and other independent entry points can establish WebRTC direct links in the background without blocking initial load, falling back to WebSocket on failure. Authorized official Relay owners can also obtain short-lived TURN candidates. Streams switch only after consistently better measurements; not all traffic uses P2P.
relay_p2p_switch_help: This switch does not affect automatic optimization for authorized Relay owners; files, voice, settings and forwarding stay on WSS.
relay_mixed_streams: WSS baseline; {count} interactive streams optimized (paths may be mixed)
relay_sent_input_uncertain: The outcome of earlier input is unconfirmed. It was not replayed automatically; check the session before continuing.
agent_tools_desc: Inspect locally installed CLI agents, ACP connectors, and versions, and check for updates on demand.
agent_tools_hint: Opening this page only scans local PATH via your startup shell without making external network requests; clicking “Check updates” queries public package registries.
agent_tools_unavailable: Unable to read local agent tool status
agent_tools_empty_installed_desc: Install any supported CLI agent and rescan, or expand the list below to copy an install command.
agent_tools_below_verified_hint: Installed version {installed} is older than verified baseline {verified}; some chat features may be unavailable
handoff_scope_expired: The preview expired. Generate a new preview.
handoff_unknown_result: The message may have been sent. Check the target session.
handoff_source_dependency: History projections are sent as ordinary text. Exact text lookup depends on the native source. Previews last five minutes.
relay_auth_description: This address uses your WebMux console login.
relay_auth_reconnecting: Reconnecting to this host. Your browser session is being checked automatically.
relay_auth_retry_stopped: The host is still unavailable. Automatic checks have paused; try again when the connection returns.
relay_auth_expired: Your relay login has expired. Sign in again to continue.
relay_auth_revoked: Relay access was revoked or you signed out. Sign in again only if this host is still shared with you.
relay_auth_unauthenticated: Sign in through the official relay to access this host.
relay_auth_drafts_kept: Keep this tab open to preserve your current page and unsent drafts. Interrupted actions are not sent again automatically.
relay_reconnect_paused: Cannot reach the host; reconnect paused
messaging_desc: Create channels, read history and send messages on this WebMux server.
messaging_config_hint: Message storage is unavailable. Check the server state directory and restart after repair.
messaging_empty_channels: Create a channel to start a conversation.
messaging_history: Refresh to check for new messages. Load earlier messages to browse history.
messaging_limit: Messages support up to 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.
messaging_send_error: The send result could not be confirmed. Your draft is retained; retrying the same draft reuses its request ID.
messaging_name_hint: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; begin with a letter or digit.
messaging_keyboard_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
messaging_welcome: A place to keep the conversation going
messaging_welcome_desc: Create a channel for your project, review or team discussion. Messages stay with this WebMux instance.
messaging_members_desc: Invite an agent running in chat mode. New messages wake idle agents and queue while they are busy.
messaging_no_available_agents: Open a supported agent in chat mode, then return to invite it. Subscribed agents appear above.
